resources.string: Keep a copy of your saved documents and recover them when needed.
Save a document to create your first backup.
Your first backup will appear here.

Saved documents, names, and tags will be uploaded to the Scaniqo backups folder in account %1$s. Projects without passwords keep their editing settings. Protected PDFs are uploaded only as PDFs with their original passwords, without editing files.
The password vault and signature library are not included in backups. Unsaved changes in the editor are not included either.
Documents will be added as new copies without replacing existing ones. Protected PDFs will still require their original passwords.
Scaniqo’s access will be removed. Your backups will remain in your Google account.
%1$d documents backed up to Google Drive.
Keep the app open until complete.

Drive did not allow the upload. Check available storage and try again later.
